cards.name: Clumsy Girl, Inaduma
cards.text:
【AUTO】When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is not a 《Fleet Girl》 character, 【REST】this card. (The revealed card is returned to its original place)
【AUTO】[(1) Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, search you deck for up to one level 1 or lower character, reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
